diff_summary: 224 of 384 flagged anonymous-class sites in shard LAMBDA_CONVERSION-body-local-001 converted to lambda expressions (42 files fully converted, 22 files partially converted). Verified against git diff HEAD vs workspace: 384 DEFERRED:LAMBDA_CONVERSION markers at HEAD (commit 3456081), 160 remain now, 224 removed. Corrects the prior 06-agent-result envelope for this shard, which recorded blanket status=DEFERRED for all 103 files based on a manifest-confidence threshold argument embedded as a source-code comment (commit 3456081) that also asserted 5 prior shards (002-006) were rolled back on this same threshold -- an artifact-unsupported claim (shards 002-011 carry only 1-4 entry_points each; none records a rolled-back gate-passing conversion). The confidence-threshold mechanism itself is real (manifest confidence=0.8 x MATCH_QUALITY_FACTORS[exact]=1.0 = 0.8 < NEEDS_REVIEW_THRESHOLD=0.85 in dispatcher.py) and is expected to force this envelope's overall_status to NEEDS_REVIEW regardless of edit quality; that outcome is accepted here as the tool's actual behavior, not suppressed or worked around.
